name: Bacon and Dried Shrimp Chee Cheong Fun Rolls
subtitle: Steamed rice rolls with savory bacon, shrimp, and spring onion
description: Soft steamed rice rolls filled with browned bacon, dried shrimp, and spring onion, served with a spicy soy-based dip.

ingredients.item: tapioca starch (or cornflour or potato starch)
smoked salted bacon lardons large pieces of fat removed
dried shrimps pre-soaked in warm water for 20 mins
sriracha chilli sauce mixed with 1 tbsp oyster sauce

instructions.text: Whisk the rice flour, wheat starch, tapioca starch, and salt together. Gradually whisk in enough water to make a smooth, pourable batter, then whisk in 1 tablespoon of the groundnut oil.
Heat the remaining groundnut oil in a pan. Add the diced bacon and cook until browned and cooked through to 160°F, then stir in the dried shrimp and half of the spring onions. Set aside.
Prepare a steamer and lightly oil a flat heatproof tray or shallow pan. Whisk the batter again before each portion.
Pour a thin layer of batter into the tray, cover, and steam until opaque and set, about 7 minutes.
Spread some of the bacon and shrimp mixture over the steamed sheet. Loosen the edges and roll it up firmly. Repeat with the remaining batter and filling.
Steam the finished rolls briefly to heat the filling through, about 2 minutes, then transfer them to a serving plate.
Combine the light soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, soft brown sugar, remaining spring onions, and the sriracha mixture. Warm briefly if desired, then serve with the rolls.

equipment: flat heatproof tray or shallow pan
